input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, messaging domain. It serves User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include advice, auth component, auth. Core business data revolves around MongoUserEntity.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to register and authenticate, so that I can securely access my account and protected resources.
As a User, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a User, I want to manage advice operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a User, I want to manage auth component operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a User, I want to manage authorization operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
